text:
sam: Pushed v2.3.1 to canary (us-east-1) a few mins ago. Deploy bot shows green. Kicking off the tick probes + a lightweight smoke sweep — please eyeball metrics.
deploy-bot: Deployment v2.3.1 -> canary/us-east-1 succeeded. Hooks: smoke,tick-probe. :white_check_mark:
maria: observed a quick p95 bump on the prefix-cache probe around 1753218920 — 120ms -> ~310ms for ~4m; no user-facing 5xx yet.
jia: can you paste the probe output / a short log snippet?
sam: dropping the small sample below (trimmed):
```text
1753218900 prefix-cache p95=120ms status=ok
1753218920 prefix-cache p95=310ms status=warn
1753218940 prefix-cache p95=140ms status=ok
```
alex: thanks. that's a short-lived spike. recommendation: keep canary running, increase synth sampling on the affected route to 10x for 15m. rollback only if either: error_rate >= 0.5% OR sustained p95 > 250ms for 5m.
maria: +1. Also propose we add a fallback routing pin so embed-route falls back to v2.2.9 on 429s or 5xx for this window.
sam: done — updated routing policy: embed-route (us-east-1) fallback=v2.2.9, threshold=5xx|429.
deploy-bot: Routing rule updated for service embed-route in us-east-1. :rocket:
ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: rollback playbook RB-12 at /runbooks/rb-12 (steps: revert canary, drain, verify smoke). Trigger only after post-check consensus.
devops-bot: quick query if you want to reproduce locally:
```bash
curl -s "https://canary.us-east-1.redwood.internal/probe/tick" | jq .metrics
```
sample output:
```json
{"p95_ms":230,"err_pct":0.12,"samples":48}
```
jia: re-ran the higher-sample probe just now: p95=230ms, err=0.12%, samples=60. No 5xx in the last 6m.
alex: that's within our guardrails. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and increment sampling every 10m for the next 30m.
sam: I'll add a one-line release note in the changelog: "v2.3.1: runtime kernel scheduling tweak for transformer runtime; staged canary + extended synth sampling." Keeping the change window open 30m from now.
maria: if anything degrades, let's call a pin/rollback fast. I'll stand by to execute.
alex: TL;DR: keep canary, extra sampling, routing fallback set, rollback criteria agreed. Promote if stable at +30m. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks team — will update here at +15m and +30m."
